sloka: सो ऽङ्गदं विविधैर्बाणैः कुम्भो विव्याध वीर्यवान्।अकुण्ठधारैर्निशितैस्तीक्ष्णैः कनकभूषणैः ।। ६.७६.४८ ।।
transliteration: so 'ṅgadaṁ vividhairbāṇaiḥ kumbho vivyādha vīryavān।akuṇṭhadhārairniśitaistīkṣṇaiḥ kanakabhūṣaṇaiḥ ।। 6.76.48 ।।

translations.english: Kumbha, a valiant hero pierced Angada continuously with several sharp and pointed arrows decked with gold.
